description: This file defines functions and types for managing Feishu message pins, including creating, removing, and listing pins via Feishu API, with internal utility functions for response validation and data normalization.

methods.name: assertFeishuPinApiSuccess
methods.description: Checks API response for success status and throws an error if failed.

methods.name: normalizePin
methods.description: Converts API pin data to internal FeishuPin type.

methods.name: createPinFeishu
methods.description: Creates a pin in Feishu chat using provided parameters.

methods.name: removePinFeishu
methods.description: Removes a pin from Feishu chat based on message ID.

methods.name: listPinsFeishu
methods.description: Lists pins in a Feishu chat with optional filtering and pagination.
